subject: general
question: At what rate of interest per annum will a sum of ₹15,625 amount to ₹19,683 in 1 year 6 months, if the interest is compounded half-yearly?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Time = 1.5 years ⇒ 3 half-yearly cycles. Ratio of Amount to Principal = 19683 / 15625 = (27 / 25)³. Multiplying factor per cycle = 27 / 25. Half-yearly rate = (27 − 25) / 25 × 100 = 8%. Annual rate = 8% × 2 = 16%. **∴ The correct answer is 16%.**
